meta.title: dsh-zotero
meta.description: dsh-zotero is an AI-native research workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness, built around your local Zotero library. Start with a research question. The agent searches for papers, extracts passages with source locations, compares papers, and generates citations. Use the literature trail to check the search scope, passages, and skipped sources. In the literature panel, you can browse collections, read PDFs, and copy citations directly.
